manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Quantum Misalignment, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Quantum Misalignment, creating a token copy of Naru Meha that isn't legendary.
Repeat from step 3.
